description: This Java class, DefaultConnectionLimitManager, enforces a limit on the number of concurrent connections based on a configurable strategy, current connection count supplier, and optional adapter configuration. It provides logic to determine and log the effective connection limit and whether that limit has been exceeded.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
classes.description: Manages and enforces a maximum connection limit for network protocols with configurable strategy and properties.

methods.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection limit manager based on strategy, current connection supplier, and optional protocol adapter properties.

methods.name: autoconfigureConnectionLimit
methods.description: Determines the connection limit automatically using the strategy's recommended limit, throwing an exception if it would be zero.

methods.name: checkConnectionLimit
methods.description: Checks if the configured limit exceeds the recommended limit and logs a warning if so.

methods.name: isLimitExceeded
methods.description: Returns true if the current number of connections exceeds or equals the limit.
